policy.heroOwnershipBoundary: Stage 3-5 does not derive Hero -> exclusive Equipment ownership. That relation is a separate Hero consumer task. Never infer ownership from name similarity, equipment order, icon naming, or release order.

restrictionSemantics.display: show generalArmyIds as broad allowed types; resolve specialJobIds through equipment_stage2_6_job_index.json only when exact exceptions need expansion.
